source: https://esta.cbp.dhs.gov/ and https://esta.cbp.dhs.gov/download/app?hideClose=true (official CBP home and printable application), plus https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/documents/Vol_49_No_17_Title.pdf (CBP mandatory-field notice); re-checked 2026-07-14. Field limits and patterns read from the ESTA application front-end on 2026-10-15: family and first name 45 characters each, passport number 6 to 10 (most issuing countries 9 at most, checked against the country's own format), email 100, phone number box digits and spaces up to 20 after a country-code list, and dates picked from day, month and year lists.

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Copy the number exactly from the VWP e-passport used for travel: 6 to 10 letters and digits. ESTA also checks the issuing country's own format; for most countries that means 9 characters at most.

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.help: ESTA has two boxes, family name and first (given) name, up to 45 characters each: letters, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens and commas. Enter every name in the Latin spelling shown on the passport.

errors.tooShort: Enter the name shown on the passport
errors.invalidChars: Letters, spaces, apostrophes, hyphens and commas only

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Match the passport date. Checked here as YYYY-MM-DD; ESTA asks it with three lists: day, month, year.

errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

email.label: Email
email.help: Use an address you control. ESTA requires email verification and sends the application number here. Up to 100 characters.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Pick the country code from ESTA's list. The number box takes digits and spaces, up to 20. If you have no phone, CBP permits a reachable third-party contact number.

errors.required: A contact phone number is required
errors.invalidFormat: Digits and spaces only, up to 20 — the country code is a separate list

home_address.label: Home address
home_address.help: Enter your current home address. CBP lists home address as required application information.

employer.label: Current or previous employer
employer.help: Answer Yes or No. If Yes, enter the current or previous employer details requested by ESTA; employer address and phone are only applicable when you have an employer to report.

errors.required: Answer whether you have a current or previous employer

us_contact.label: U.S. point of contact
us_contact.help: Use a friend, relative, business contact, or the place you will stay. CBP permits UNKNOWN when you do not know the information.

errors.required: Enter a U.S. contact, place of stay, or UNKNOWN

social_media.label: Social media
social_media.help: The current official ESTA printable application labels this section Optional. Add identifiers if you choose, select no online presence when applicable, or leave it blank.

errors.invalidOption: Choose a listed option or leave this optional field blank
